Quick ops read on the audit checklist: we emit order_id, timestamp, model_id, tokens_billed, customer_tenant_id, and region in our event stream today. Two gaps and one caution: 

1) Gaps: reseller_fee_line is not emitted as a distinct field currently — we calculate fees post-facto in billing. We can add a reseller_fee_code that maps to the invoice line, but this requires a small pipeline change (1 sprint) and a migration for historical reconciliation.

2) PII & sample exchange: we can produce redacted order IDs (hashes) plus the mapping internally for reconciliation under an NDA/auditor request.

3) Caution: Nimbus’ redline asks for "full transaction CSV for any audit" — that’s broad. We should propose language limiting audit to a mutually agreed sample set and remediation window (e.g., disputes raised within 90 days).

Proposed ops deliverables: 
- Add reseller_fee_code to event schema (ETA 2 weeks)
- Provide weekly reconciliation report that maps reseller_fee_code -> invoice line (ETA 3 weeks)

If legal wants narrower wording, I can work with infra to produce a template export for auditors (sampled + redacted).

Marissa/Ben —

Thanks for looping me in. I reviewed the Nimbus redline and propose compromise language on two key points: 

1) Audit scope: allow Nimbus to request production of aggregate reports and up to two sampled, redacted transaction sets per 12-month period; any additional or full raw data requests must be subject to a narrow auditor engagement and our mutual NDA. 2) Pass-through fees: require Redwood to provide a monthly reconciliation report, and include an invoice reference field ("partner_invoice_ref") in our pass-through line. However, add explicit language that credits/refunds caused by downstream customer disputes are handled per our standard billing correction policy and must be raised within 90 days.

I attached a marked-up redline containing the suggested edits. If Nimbus accepts this bridge we can incorporate the language into the Order Form Attachment and prepare a DocuSign packet.
